interface.shortDescription: Turn a voice recording into an animated vertical Short
interface.longDescription: Voice note in, animated vertical Short out: word-level captions, kinetic typography, camera moves, synthesized sound design and a voice-ducked music bed. The workflow runs entirely on your machine using local transcription, headless Chromium rendering, and FFmpeg encoding.
